dgl1ContentOrder.purpose: Author a whole same-ID first-order-solving assessment instead of importing second-order oscillations into the 44 GK scopes.
dgl1ContentOrder.concreteTaskDesign: Use one genuinely separable elementary first-order equation, derive a parameterised solution family, obtain a particular solution from an initial condition and verify it by substitution/differentiation. A narrow candidate is y′=y², y(0)=1: nonzero solutions 1/(C−t), the equilibrium solution y=0 must not be lost by division, and the initial solution is 1/(1−t) on the interval containing 0, t<1. A short y′=2t case can represent direct integration as another elementary method if needed. These are authoring examples, not a released task or new mandatory list of all methods.
dgl1ContentOrder.preparationCheck: Independently check the actual complete 28c context, algebra/differentiation work and method burden before freezing. The present R includes primitive powers x^n for integer n≠−1, so separation via y^−2 avoids importing logarithmic integration. If an example needs genuinely new preparation, revise the example or submit a separately justified minimal R change, never create coverage-driven R.
dgl1ContentOrder.wholeGoalAndFairness: Cover meaningful first-order solving, general/special solutions and initial conditions under one ordinary total score. No second-order/trigonometric/oscillator demand, no exhaustive catalogue of every solution method, no prerequisite pass thresholds. Do not claim content approval before actual complete task, solutions, rubric and independent review.
dgl1ContentOrder.existingAlternativeBoundary: The existing 97fb Richtungsfeld/temperature exam assesses qualitative interpretation and field construction, not deriving general/special solutions; unchanged it is not a replacement for 28c. Do not add 28c to its R/Coverage just to close a gap.
